subject: Parking lot resurfacing next week
body:
Heads up that the main visitor lot will be resurfaced Monday through Wednesday next week. Staff parking will shift temporarily to the overflow lot behind the west building. Signs will be posted, thanks for your patience.

Facilities Management

subject: Welcome our two new hires
body:
Please join us in welcoming Dr. Priya Ramanathan to Internal Medicine and Jordan Kessler to our billing team, both starting Monday. Feel free to stop by and say hello during their first week.

HR Communications

subject: Cafeteria menu update
body:
Starting next month the cafeteria will be offering an expanded vegetarian menu and extending hours until 7pm on weekdays. Full menu is posted on the intranet if you'd like a preview.

Dining Services

subject: Reminder: badge photo day is Thursday
body:
If your ID badge photo is more than three years old, stop by the security office anytime Thursday between 9 and 3 to get an updated one taken. No appointment needed.

Security Office

subject: Building A elevator schedule
body:
The north elevator in Building A will be serviced this Friday from 7am to noon. The south elevator and stairwell will remain available throughout. Thanks for planning accordingly.

Facilities

subject: New coffee machines in the break rooms
body:
You may have noticed the new coffee machines installed in the second and third floor break rooms this week. Instructions are posted nearby, let facilities know if you run into any issues.

Operations Team

subject: Staff satisfaction survey closes Friday
body:
Just a reminder that the annual staff satisfaction survey closes this Friday. It takes about 8 minutes and your feedback genuinely shapes next year's priorities. Link is on the intranet homepage.

Human Resources

subject: Congratulations to our Employee of the Quarter
body:
We're pleased to recognize Angela Ferris from the front desk team as this quarter's Employee of the Quarter, nominated by her colleagues for consistently going above and beyond. Congratulations, Angela!

Leadership Team

subject: Update on the cafeteria renovation
body:
The main cafeteria renovation is on track to finish by the end of the month. In the meantime, the temporary seating area near the east entrance remains open during regular hours.

Facilities Management

subject: Reminder: flu shot clinic dates
body:
The employee flu shot clinic will run in the main lobby this Tuesday and Wednesday from 7am to 3pm. Walk-ins welcome, no appointment necessary. Bring your insurance card if you have one.

Employee Health

subject: New bike racks installed
body:
Thanks to everyone who requested it, we've added additional bike racks near the south entrance. Feel free to use them starting this week.

Facilities

subject: Holiday schedule reminder
body:
As we approach the holidays, please remember to submit any time off requests through the usual portal by the end of next week so scheduling can plan ahead. Thanks in advance.

Staff Scheduling

subject: Town hall next Wednesday
body:
Join us for the quarterly town hall next Wednesday at noon in the main auditorium, or watch the livestream from your desk. Leadership will cover this year's priorities and take questions.

Communications Team

subject: New hand sanitizer stations
body:
You'll now find additional hand sanitizer stations near each department entrance as part of our ongoing infection control efforts. Thanks for helping keep our facility safe.

Infection Control

subject: Update your emergency contact info
body:
It's that time of year, please take a moment to log into the HR portal and confirm your emergency contact information is current. Takes less than five minutes.

Human Resources

subject: Volunteers needed for the community health fair
body:
We're looking for a few volunteers to help staff our booth at the community health fair next month. If you're interested, reply to this email and we'll send details.

Community Outreach

subject: New printer in the west wing
body:
A new printer has been installed near the west wing nurses' station to help with the queue during busy shifts. Driver installation instructions are on the intranet.

IT Support

subject: Reminder: annual compliance photos
body:
If you haven't already had your annual compliance photo taken for your staff directory listing, the photographer will be set up in the main lobby this Friday from 10 to 2.

Compliance Office

subject: Thank you for a great fundraiser
body:
Thanks to everyone who contributed to this year's charity walk, we raised over $14,000 for the children's ward renovation fund. Great turnout from every department.

Community Outreach

subject: Scheduled fire drill this month
body:
As required annually, we'll be conducting a scheduled fire drill sometime in the next two weeks. Please review the evacuation routes posted near the stairwells when you have a moment.

Safety Office

subject: Cafeteria closed for deep clean
body:
The cafeteria will be closed this Sunday for its scheduled deep clean and equipment maintenance. It will reopen Monday morning at the usual time.

Dining Services

subject: Update on the new EHR training rollout
body:
Optional refresher sessions on the recent EHR update are being offered this week in the training room. Sign up on the intranet if you'd like a spot, no obligation to attend.

Clinical Informatics

subject: Reminder: annual picnic is this Saturday
body:
Just a friendly reminder that the staff and family picnic is this Saturday at Riverside Park starting at noon. Bring the family, food and drinks will be provided.

Employee Engagement Committee

subject: New signage in the main lobby
body:
You may notice updated wayfinding signage going up in the main lobby this week to help patients find departments more easily. Let us know if you spot anything confusing.

Facilities

subject: Thank you to the night shift team
body:
A quick note of appreciation to our overnight team for covering seamlessly during last week's system outage. Your steadiness made a real difference for patients.

Nursing Administration

subject: Break room microwave replaced
body:
The microwave in the third floor break room has been replaced after last week's malfunction. Please remember to cover food when heating it up.

Facilities

subject: New online scheduling tool for meeting rooms
body:
Starting next week, conference room bookings will move to the new online scheduling tool. A short how-to guide is posted on the intranet.

Operations Team

subject: Update: guest wifi password change
body:
The guest wifi password will be updated this weekend as part of routine maintenance. The new password will be posted at the front desk and in patient waiting areas.

IT Department

subject: Reminder: submit your CME hours
body:
If you haven't logged your CME hours for this cycle yet, there's still time before the deadline next month. Reach out to medical education if you have questions about what qualifies.

Medical Education Office

subject: New vending machine options
body:
Based on feedback from the last staff survey, the vending machines in the break rooms now include more low sugar and gluten free snack options.

Facilities

subject: Update on the roof repair project
body:
The roof repair project over the east wing is progressing on schedule and should wrap up by the end of the month with minimal disruption expected going forward.

Facilities Management

subject: Staff lounge furniture upgrade
body:
New seating has been installed in the main staff lounge based on requests from last quarter's survey. Come check it out on your next break.

Facilities

subject: Reminder: submit expense reports by Friday
body:
Just a reminder that expense reports for this month need to be submitted by end of day Friday to be included in this cycle's reimbursement run.

Accounting

subject: New signage for the pharmacy pickup window
body:
You'll notice new directional signage near the pharmacy pickup window to help reduce congestion during peak hours. Thanks for your patience while patients adjust.

Pharmacy Operations

subject: Update: department potluck this Friday
body:
Don't forget the radiology department potluck this Friday at noon in the staff lounge. Sign up sheet for dishes is on the breakroom fridge.

Radiology Team

subject: New bulletin board in the break room
body:
We've added a new community bulletin board in the main break room for staff announcements, carpooling requests, and the like. Feel free to post there going forward.

Human Resources

subject: Reminder to update your mailing address
body:
If you've moved recently, please update your mailing address in the HR system so your year end tax documents go to the right place.

Human Resources

subject: Thank you for your patience during construction
body:
We appreciate everyone's flexibility during the ongoing lobby construction. The project remains on track and we'll share updates as milestones are reached.

Facilities Management

subject: New recycling bins added
body:
You'll now find recycling bins alongside the regular trash bins in every break room and hallway as part of our sustainability initiative. Thanks for participating.

Facilities

subject: Staff appreciation week schedule
body:
Staff appreciation week kicks off next Monday with a different treat or activity each day, details posted on the intranet. Thanks for everything you do.

Employee Engagement Committee

subject: Update on badge access to the new wing
body:
Badge access to the newly opened south wing will be enabled for all clinical staff starting Monday. If your badge doesn't work, stop by security to have it updated.

Security Office

subject: Reminder: annual eye wash station inspection
body:
Facilities will be conducting the annual inspection of eye wash stations throughout the building next week, a routine safety check, no action needed on your part.

Safety Office

subject: New mentorship program open for sign ups
body:
We're launching a peer mentorship program for new clinical staff this quarter. If you're interested in mentoring or being mentored, sign up on the intranet by the end of the month.

Professional Development

subject: Reminder: submit your holiday coverage preferences
body:
Please submit your holiday coverage preferences through the scheduling portal by next Friday so the team can finalize the calendar with plenty of notice.

Staff Scheduling

subject: Great turnout at last week's open house
body:
Thanks to everyone who helped make last week's community open house a success, we had a great turnout and a lot of positive feedback from visitors.

Community Outreach

subject: New water bottle filling stations
body:
New water bottle filling stations have been installed near the main stairwells on each floor. We hope this helps cut down on disposable cup use.

Facilities

subject: Quiet room now open on the third floor
body:
A new quiet room for staff to decompress during breaks is now open on the third floor near the east stairwell. Please keep noise to a minimum out of respect for others using the space.

Employee Wellness
